language_aware_gate.why: A cross-lingual query is indistinguishable from a monolingual one from the query side. Same-language BM25 returns same-language chunks, which are by construction not the gold when the answer lives in the other language. Only gold reveals cross-linguality, and reading it at routing time would be evaluation leakage.

main_benchmark_v1.note: HYBRID_RRF_30 had a significant nDCG@10 gain (+0.0910, CI [+0.0641,+0.1206]) but non-significant Recall@10/MRR@10 deltas

tradeoff_accepted: Giving up a statistically significant monolingual nDCG gain to protect cross-lingual retrieval, because the corpus is bilingual and cross-lingual retrieval is a required capability.
